rows.basis: Growth in gross 'Information technology assets' (servers and network equipment): 66,267M − 55,606M = 10,661M. This counts all server and network growth, not only AI, is net of any disposals, and excludes data center buildings and construction in progress.

Growth in gross 'Information technology assets': 80,594M − 66,267M = 14,327M. This counts all server and network growth, not only AI, and excludes buildings and construction in progress. The FY2024 10-K's 'Technical infrastructure' (112,504M at FY2023) is broader, so the two series are not mixed.

Growth in gross 'Technical infrastructure': 141,852M − 112,504M = 29,348M. The recast category totals tie to the old ones only if it also absorbs data center land and buildings, so this includes shells as well as servers and network gear (all of it, not only AI). Assets not yet in service are excluded. The FY2024 balance is unresolved against XBRL.

Growth in gross 'Technical infrastructure': 203,679M − 141,852M = 61,827M. It includes data center buildings as well as servers and network equipment, not only AI. Assets not yet in service (78,592M at year end) are excluded. The MD&A says capex is 'in particular for AI' but gives no share.
FY2022 MD&A: continued investment in technical infrastructure 'in particular in support of AI'; total-capex language with no amount or share.
FY2023 MD&A: technical infrastructure investment to increase versus 2023, 'in particular in support of AI products and services'; no amount or share.
Guidance of ~$75B (Q4 2024 release), raised to ~$85B (Q2 2025 release), is total capex, not the AI part. The FY2024 MD&A says the increase is 'in particular in support of AI'. No AI share is given.
June 2026 equity issuance with $49.6B net proceeds is for general corporate purposes 'including capital expenditures to scale AI infrastructure'. These are financing proceeds, not an AI capex amount.

Unallocated corporate costs 'primarily include AI-focused shared R&D activities, including development costs of our general AI models', mixed with philanthropy and corporate shared costs; no amount isolated in the pack.
Same disclosure: unallocated/Alphabet-level costs primarily AI-focused shared R&D including general AI model development; the pack has no amount for that line.
'Alphabet-level activities primarily reflect expenses related to our shared AI research and development'; the pack does not contain the Alphabet-level cost amount.
FY2025 MD&A: technical infrastructure operating costs (depreciation, energy, equipment, network) 'expected to significantly increase' because AI needs more compute; no amount.
